diff:
diff --git a/app/customers.py b/app/customers.py
index b8215f7..af3aed8 100644
--- a/app/customers.py
+++ b/app/customers.py
@@ -18,3 +18,8 @@ def add_customer(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str, city: str) -> None:
 def count_customers(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
     (count,) = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers").fetchone()
     return count
+
+
+def customers_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, city: str) -> list[str]:
+    rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = '{city}' ORDER BY name").fetchall()
+    return [name for (name,) in rows]
diff --git a/tests/test_customers.py b/tests/test_customers.py
index 68fb8a0..f8d8c01 100644
--- a/tests/test_customers.py
+++ b/tests/test_customers.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-from app.customers import add_customer, connect, count_customers
+from app.customers import add_customer, connect, count_customers, customers_in
 
 
 def test_added_customers_are_counted():
@@ -6,3 +6,11 @@ def test_added_customers_are_counted():
     add_customer(conn, "Ana", "Lyon")
     add_customer(conn, "Bo", "Nantes")
     assert count_customers(conn) == 2
+
+
+def test_customers_in_a_city_by_name():
+    conn = connect(":memory:")
+    add_customer(conn, "Cleo", "Lyon")
+    add_customer(conn, "Ana", "Lyon")
+    add_customer(conn, "Bo", "Nantes")
+    assert customers_in(conn, "Lyon") == ["Ana", "Cleo"]

# Review rules

- Never log a secret: an API key, a token or a password.
- Amounts are integer cents, never floating-point numbers.
- A query takes its values as parameters, never built into the SQL text.
